description: Build a post-distillation review agent system that validates distilled HTML outputs, routes uncertain items to human review, iterates review quality, and delivers the best final distilled HTML output.

userStories.title: Define the post-distill review contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a stable review contract so that post-distillation agents can classify, compare, and escalate items consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the required item fields for post-distill review outputs: item_id, source_id, raw_text, routing result, reviewer verdict, confidence, and human escalation
Define allowed verdict labels: pass, reject, needs_review, multi_candidate, reclassify
Define the human review pack fields and grouping keys
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Validate the coordinator and routing reviewer
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the coordinator and routing reviewer validated by a subagent so that distilled items are routed to the right dimension or human review.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a coordinator agent that only operates on distilled outputs
Add a routing reviewer that checks whether the assigned category matches the item’s semantic function
Routing reviewer outputs route_ok, reclassify, multi_candidate, or route_to_human
A validation subagent confirms the routing flow works end to end
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create and validate D1-D4 structure reviewers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want reviewers for macro blueprint, section argument, rhetorical moves, and paragraph templates so that high-level structure can be judged automatically and checked by a second agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add reviewer definitions for macro blueprint, section argument structure, rhetorical moves, and paragraph templates
Each reviewer uses semantic-first judgment and escalates uncertain cases to human review
Each reviewer returns pass, reject, or needs_review with a human_question when uncertain
A second evaluation subagent summarizes the quality of the D1-D4 review results
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create and validate D5-D8 content-pattern reviewers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want reviewers for sentence patterns, terminology collocation, tense/voice/hedging, and claim-evidence binding so that reusable phrasing and evidence support are checked automatically and re-evaluated.
acceptanceCriteria: Add reviewer definitions for sentence patterns, terminology collocation, tense/voice/hedging, and claim-evidence binding
Sentence pattern review requires slot flexibility and reusable function
Claim-evidence review rejects unsupported strong claims
A second evaluation subagent summarizes the quality of the D5-D8 review results
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create and validate D9-D11 linkage and innovation reviewers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want reviewers for figure-text linkage, related-work positioning, and innovation phrasing so that visual linkage, prior-work positioning, and novelty claims are checked automatically and audited for quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Add reviewer definitions for figure-text linkage, related-work positioning, and innovation phrasing
Related-work review distinguishes background from true positioning moves
Innovation review requires mechanism, gain, and boundary or escalates to human review
A quality-evaluation subagent reviews the D9-D11 outputs and records improvement suggestions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Assemble the human review pack
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want unresolved items consolidated into a human review pack so that I can manually finish uncertain cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Uncertain items from routing and all reviewers are grouped into a human review pack
The human review pack preserves evidence chains and conflict notes
Human review items are grouped by dimension and conflict type
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Iterate review and distillation improvements
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to run the distill-review-improve-verify loop so that review standards and distilled outputs converge toward the best achievable result.
acceptanceCriteria: Use review results to produce concrete improvement suggestions
Apply the improvement suggestions to the distillation and review flow
Repeat validation until no further obvious improvements are available
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build and verify the final best HTML output
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the best final distilled HTML output regenerated and verified so that I can inspect the final review-ready result.
acceptanceCriteria: Regenerate the final distilled HTML output from the best review iteration
The final HTML reflects the latest review decisions and human escalations
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
